admission.justification: Guarded by test_early_refusal_is_compact_single_line_and_knowledge_read_bound_unchanged and prevents indented JSON plus duplicate structuredContent from doubling refusal wire bytes or accidentally shrinking knowledge_read's 5,000-token ceiling.

applicability: Every early-return transport guard refusal built by mcp/tool_results.py::build_early_refusal_result and the knowledge_read 5,000-token bound in models/tools/tool_answer.py.
conditions: An MCP call is refused by a transport guard before entering the tool handler.
exclusions: Normal handler results built by build_call_tool_result and protocol-level ToolError exceptions.
statement: Early transport refusals emit single-line compact UTF-8 JSON TextContent with no structuredContent, and knowledge_read retains its 5,000-token exception bound.
title: Early transport refusals emit compact JSON without structuredContent
